deadline.value: Each PhD position has its own closing date. The example quoted (genome evolution in unicellular eukaryotes) closes 2 November 2026.
deadline.quote: up to and including 2nd of November 2026

also.quote: apply for an already funded position via a vacancy

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

supervisor.value: The vacancy asks applicants to contact the postdoc supervising the position for more information.
supervisor.quote: please contact Ursula Oggenfuss, Postdoc, via email: ursula.oggenfuss@wur.nl

funding.value: The page says funding must be guaranteed before a PhD can start, which is a condition of admission, not a funding rule.

entry_route.value: Applicants must hold a master's degree comparable to a Dutch master's degree.
entry_route.quote: The candidate must hold a master’s degree that is comparable to a Dutch master’s degree

notes: EPS covers plant molecular biology, plant physiology and plant growth research (graduate schools page). The vacancy quoted does not name its graduate school or chair group, so it is the nearest official example, not proof of the EPS route. WIAS (animal sciences) is not used for biology because its page gives only a research mission.
